task: ae.book: limit order book matching engine (price-time priority, iceberg reload-to-back, IOC/FOK/post-only, self-trade stop, amend/replace) with naive-oracle differential tests, invariant corruption tests and a 26-mutant pass
reasoning_summary: Wrote the rules into TASK.md, then tests first: 28 hand-derived literal cases, a seeded differential test against a flat-list oracle that re-sorts on every match, reflection-built corruption tests for every invariant rule, and a 26-mutant pass. The only failure was a compile error (record component named postOnly clashed with the postOnly() wither), fixed by renaming the component to post. One mutant survived as equivalent (FOK own-level return), so the redundant expression was simplified and the invariant mutants gained dedicated corruption tests.
